— ABOUT THE CABIN —



"The highlight of a 7-day trip to Norway" — those are the guests' own words. Konglehytta 3 has been named one of Norway's 110 most unique accommodations by Vagabond Reiselyst, and pets are just as welcome as the rest of the group.



Private sauna, fire pan, and a starry sky over Mjøslis forest that none of the guests will forget. Barbecue. Go to the sauna. Stare at the stars for hours. That's exactly what guests do here. Annex for two extra guests available if needed.

The space
30 minutes from Gardermoen.



For two couples, a family with a dog, or four people who want to see Norway's starry sky from a cabin in the woods.



 • Private sauna with terrace and fire pit

 • Starlit sky without light pollution

 • Pet friendly — pets most welcome

 • One of Norway's 110 most unique overnight stays (Vagabond Riselyst)

 • Private annex — sleeps up to 4 guests in total

 • Linens, towels, and basic items included



— WHAT GUESTS SAY —



 «The highlight of the entire 7-day Norway trip. We grilled, walked in a sauna and stared at the stars for hours – none of the other places we stayed had such a beautiful star view. We would love to extend our stay. Great!»



— BEDROOMS —

 • Konglehytta – Double bed (2 guests)

 • Royal annex – Double bed (2 guests)



The annex costs extra and is activated when booking for 3-4 guests. Add the number of guests to the booking — the price will be updated automatically.



— INDOORS —

 • Private sauna

 • Kitchen with hob, fridge and cookware

 • Bathroom with shower and toilet

 • WiFi



— OUTDOOR —

 • Fire pit and terrace

 • Electric car chargers in the shared parking lot — Budalsvegen 38

— CHECK IN —

We'll send you a personal code to the electronic door lock prior to your arrival — no keys to keep track of, and you can check in at your convenience.



Car is needed to get to the property.



Check in from 4pm — check out by 11am.



— LOCATION —

 • Self-service kiosk in the reception building — 24 hours (eggs, meat, souvenirs and kiosk items)

 • 15 min – Kiwi Minnesund (closest grocery)

 • 30 min – Gardermoen airport

 • 30 min – Hamar (shopping, restaurants, city life)

 • 30m – Atlungstad Brenneri and Restaurant

 • 20 min – Tangen Dyrehage (summer open)

 • 50 min – Budor ski resort



Food items can be delivered to the cottage via Oda — to be ordered online.

Good roads in summer and winter — the parking is cleared.



All properties from Villa Heidi Cottage rental include sheets, towels and staples. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions!

FAQ



Question: Does Konglehytta 3 have a hot tub or sauna?

Answer: Konglehytta 3 has a private wood-fired sauna with direct access to the terrace and fire pit. There is no hot tub at this cabin.



Question: Can you see the stars from Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Yes — Konglehytta 3 is known for its exceptional starry sky from the outdoor area. One guest described it as "the most beautiful star view of the entire 7-day trip to Norway."



Question: How many people can sleep in Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Konglehytta 3 has space for 2 guests in the main part and 2 guests in the private annex — a total of 4. The annex costs extra and is automatically activated when booking for 3-4 guests.



Question: Are pets welcome at Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Yes, Konglehytta 3 is pet-friendly — pets are absolutely welcome.



Question: What is Konglehytta 3 best suited for?

Answer: Konglehytta 3 is good for two couples, a family with a dog, or four friends who want a private sauna, starry sky, and a fire pit in the woods. The cabin has been named one of Norway's 110 most unique accommodations by Vagabond Reiselyst.



Question: When are check-in and check-out at Konglehytta 3?

Reply: Check-in from 4 pm, check-out by 11:00 AM. You will receive a personal code for the electronic door lock in advance — no reception required.



Question: Are bed linens and towels included at Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Yes — bed linens, towels and basic kitchen and bathroom items are always included in the price.



Question: Does Konglehytta 3 have WiFi?

Answer: Yes, Konglehytta 3 has Wi-Fi.



Question: How do I get to Konglehytta 3?

Answer: A car is required — Konglehytta 3 is located in Mjøsli, about 30 minutes from Gardermoen and 1 hour from Oslo. Electric car chargers are available in the shared parking lot at Budalsvegen 38.



Question: Where is the nearest food store from Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Kiwi Minnesund is 15 minutes away. There is also a self-service 24-hour kiosk in the reception building at Mjøsli with eggs, meat, and kiosk items. Groceries can be ordered via Oda and delivered to the cabin.



Question: What can you do near Konglehytta 3?

Answer: Walking and cross-country skiing trails start right near Mjøsli. Atlungstad Distillery and Restaurant is 30 minutes away, Tangen Zoo 20 minutes (summer season), and Budor ski resort 50 minutes.

Wonderful setting, unique stay. The private sauna was amazing & so relaxing. The bed & bedding were the most comfortable of any stay we've ever had. Beautiful surroundings to sit about with an outdoor fire & to view from indoor, especially from the bed in the morning. Everything, including the bathroom was spotless. Heidi was quickly responsive, friendly and helpful with our extra questions once we arrived. It was well worth the money & wish we could have stayed longer. There should be a higher class for airbnbs like this one, as this is top tier!
